name: Call of Fire
summary: Telf Joolam sends a shaman across Durotar and the eastern Barrens for a Fire Sapta's ingredients. The draught prepares an initiate to perceive and speak with fire spirits.

sections.title: Brewing the Fire Sapta
sections.body: A Fire Sapta opens a shaman’s senses to the Eternal Flame. Like the draught for earth, it lets a shaman see and speak with spirits hidden from mortal sight. Telf Joolam sends initiates across Durotar and into the eastern Barrens to gather ingredients bound to heat and flame.

sections.title: Enemies and Elements
sections.body: Razormane quilboar spellcasters in the eastern Barrens carry fire tar, made in their earthy rituals. Burning Blade cultists carry the other needed ingredient in Dustwind Cave, in the ravines northeast of Razor Hill. The cultists use fire for destruction and demonic chaos, while the reagents in their pouches hold a natural tie to the element.

sections.title: The Nature of Flame
sections.body: Telf Joolam teaches that fire brings more than destruction and ruin. It also gives warmth and light, and makes creation possible. A wise shaman understands how opposing forces give meaning to each other and uses contrasting elements together, rather than wielding fire only as a weapon.

faq.answer: A Fire Sapta is a ritual draught made with ingredients tied to fire. Drinking it briefly aligns a shaman’s spirit and vision with the plane of fire, revealing its spirits so the shaman can speak with them.

faq.q: Where do I find the Fire Tar?
faq.answer: Razormane quilboar spellcasters carry fire tar in the eastern Barrens, across the Southfury River from Durotar. Geomancers, Seers, Mystics, and Thornweavers often carry pots of the thick, flammable mixture for tribal rites.

faq.q: Where is the Reagent Pouch found?
faq.answer: Burning Blade cultists carry the reagent pouch in Dustwind Cave, above the ravines northeast of Razor Hill in Durotar. The cave is distinct from Skull Rock, farther north near the coast.

faq.q: Why does a shaman use items from warlocks?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam needs ingredients saturated with fire for the Sapta. Burning Blade cultists invoke destructive demonic flames, and their spell pouches hold potent reagents tied to fire.

Telf Joolam is a solitary troll shaman whose camp lies atop Durotar’s crags, south of Razor Hill. He oversees the trials of fire for Horde initiates and guides them in balancing destruction with creation.

aliases: what to do with fire sapta
faq.answer: After Telf Joolam makes the Fire Sapta from the gathered ingredients, he sends you to the fiery heights of the nearby dormant peak. You drink it there, face the elemental spirit, and earn your fire totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you face a trial in balancing opposing forces. Flame can bring vitality and light as well as wrath when wisdom guides it.
As a Horde defender, you face threats on the borders: Razormane quilboar encroaching in the Barrens and Burning Blade cultists hidden within Durotar.
As an orc, you confront the Burning Blade and the warlock magic that once corrupted your people. Reclaiming fire as a natural element is an act of cultural restoration.
